+# parity_check <name> <root>: the Go and Python engines must report the identical
+# set of FAIL findings for the same tree. This is a behavioral comparison of the
+# two rule engines, not a text match against the Python source.
+parity_check() {
+  [ -n "$GOBIN_CHECK" ] || return 0
+  local py go
+  if [ "$#" -ge 3 ]; then
+    py="$(printf '%s\n' "$3" | grep '^FAIL' | sort)"
+  else
+    py="$(python3 "$CHECK" --root "$2" 2>&1 | grep '^FAIL' | sort)"
+  fi
+  go="$("$GOBIN_CHECK" --root "$2" 2>/dev/null | grep '^FAIL' | sort)"
+  if [ "$py" != "$go" ]; then
+    fail "$1" "Go and Python checkers report different findings"
+    diff <(printf '%s\n' "$py") <(printf '%s\n' "$go") | head -6 >&2
+    return 1
+  fi
+  return 0
+}
+
+parity_check "real tree parity (Go == Python)" "$ROOT" && pass "Go and Python checkers agree on the real tree"

+# FAST mode samples one plant per section, so prove nothing is lost: every plant
+# this wrapper declares must also be in the Go mutation inventory, i.e. each skipped
+# plant is still proven by the full in-memory suite. (The Go suite may hold extra
+# Go-only mutations, such as deleted files, that cannot be planted from shell.)
+if [ "$FAST" = 1 ]; then
+  # Self-check every sampled-out plant: its expression must still mutate the pristine
+  # tree copy (the tree is byte-verified clean after each plant above).
+  if [ "$SKIPPED_N" -gt 0 ]; then
+    if stale="$(python3 - "$TMP/tree" "$TMP/skipped" "$SKIPPED_N" <<'PY'
+import sys
+tree, d, n = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2], int(sys.argv[3])
+bad = []
+for i in range(1, n + 1):
+    rd = lambda ext: open(f"{d}/{i}.{ext}", encoding="utf-8").read()
+    name, rel, expr = rd("name"), rd("file"), rd("expr")
+    try:
+        text = open(f"{tree}/{rel}", encoding="utf-8").read()
+    except FileNotFoundError:
+        text = ""
+    try:
+        if eval(expr, {"text": text}) == text:
+            bad.append(name + " (no-op)")
+    except Exception as e:
+        bad.append(f"{name} ({type(e).__name__})")
+if bad:
+    print("; ".join(bad))
+    raise SystemExit(1)
+PY
+)"; then
+      pass "all $SKIPPED_N sampled-out plants still apply to the pristine tree"
+    else
+      fail "sampled-out plants" "mutation did not apply: $stale"
+    fi
+  fi
+  missing_in_go="$(comm -23 <(printf '%s\n' "${PLANT_NAMES[@]}" | sort -u) <("$GOBIN_CHECK" --list-mutations | sort -u))"
+  if [ -n "$missing_in_go" ]; then
+    fail "mutation inventory" "shell plants with no Go counterpart: $(printf '%s' "$missing_in_go" | tr '\n' ';')"
+  else
+    pass "every shell plant has a Go counterpart (${#PLANT_NAMES[@]} planted regressions)"
+  fi
+fi
